rows.label: Commands to see, trim, clear and verify the local cache
rows.n: ◐: a clear or purge command (nx reset, bazel clean, rush purge, moon clean, cargo clean, plz clean); npm has `cache verify`, pnpm `cache prune`.

rows.label: Local cache kept under a size limit automatically
rows.n: Nx: maxCacheSize; Turborepo: eviction by age; Earthly: garbage collection of layers.
